articles.title: Is That a Secret Hum? Scientists Might Have Found Where It Comes From!
articles.summary: Have you ever heard a weird humming noise that nobody else can hear? Scientists studied 28 people in Germany who hear 'The Hum' to figure out if the sound comes from outside or inside our bodies.

articles.title: The Dinosaur-Killing Rock Was a Rare Space Visitor!
articles.summary: The giant space rock that wiped out the dinosaurs 66 million years ago was a rare type of meteorite called a CO chondrite. Scientists figured this out by studying tiny bits of nickel left behind in clay all around the world.

articles.title: This Robot Builder Can Put Together Satellites in Space!
articles.summary: Sarah Downs, a student engineer, created a smart computer program that helps a robot put antennas on satellites in space—without using cameras! Her work with NASA and the Air Force could change how we build things in orbit.
